recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "The First Meeting of the Great Whiteboard Brotherhood", "body": "Chance Garton opens episode 139 by initiating everyone into what he jokes is a brand new cult with three requirements: you have to be a brother, you have to be great, and you have to own and use a whiteboard, which he has finally done. He describes the Great Whiteboard Brotherhood as a sink tank rather than a think tank, a synchronicity driven crew whose name he thinks Paranoid American may have coined, played against the esoteric Great White Brotherhood. Returning guest PK joins Gabe (Slick Dissident) for a laid back research hangout, with call ins to the vibe rant hotline and super chats from Liam and Ari."}, {"title": "Verbs, Nouns and the Babylon Mentality", "body": "Gabe traces the night's current back to a show he did with George on Third Eye Edify, where he walked the Odyssey through the Enneagram in reverse, noting that the first word of the poem, mania or rage, is an anagram of Enneagram. From there he argues that ancient Greek placed control in the verb rather than the noun, that the letter row, number 19 in Greek, became our possessive apostrophe S, and that surnames ending in O R or E R still mark what a family does for a living. He calls the noun heavy paradigm Babylon mentality, where your possessions own you."}, {"title": "Jung, Synchronicity and Manufactured Facts", "body": "Chance argues that facts are constructions, pointing out that fact descends from the Latin facere, meaning to make or fabricate. Reading Carl Jung more closely, he relays Jung's conclusion that the greater part of the psyche lies outside the personal self, so the consensus world is the densest and least budgeable layer of mind. His case study is the 1947 pilot he names as Keith Arnold, who said nine luminescent craft moved like saucers and was misquoted as reporting flying saucers, after which sightings broke out everywhere. Chance contends this shows intelligence operating through correspondence, and that building your own systems of correspondence takes that power back."}, {"title": "Hunting the Missing Digamma", "body": "PK runs eleven screenshots on the digamma, the sixth letter of the Greek alphabet, which he says went missing and was gradually simplified until it was no more than a large comma, our apostrophe. He tracks it through the stigma, the stauros or cross at 777, the Chi Xi Stigma of Revelation 13:18, and words such as Orion, anax and Aphrodite, where a lost W or V sound still leaves traces. Chance reconstructs Deus on his whiteboard as D I V O S and asks where the World Economic Forum meets: Davos. Gabe ties the number six to the Enneagram loyalist, the muse Erato and the maxim have no dogma."}, {"title": "Alpha to Omega, and a Closing Round of Prophecy", "body": "In the last stretch Chance puts the digamma back into the alphabet so the letter M lands dead center, links the Hebrew aleph mem tav to the Latin amo and the Hindu Om, and reads the Chi Rho as row plus tau, 200 plus 400, the 600 years he says separate incarnations of the savior. Gabe closes on Hume's is and ought problem, the replication crisis, and a 7/22 weave in which Joe Biden's withdrawal meets a new formula for pi. He predicts section three of the 14th Amendment will be turned on Trump, and says he would rather see the amendment nullified outright."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Get ready to be initiated into the mysteries of the Great Whiteboard Brotherhood, the mystical sync-tank of our boy Slick Dissident. Tonight we take aim at the new word order imposed by centuries of linguistic drift that's gradually transferred power from verb to noun. What happens when you use Hume's Guillotine on Occam's Razor? Just because a noun represents us, ought we believe that we are our pronouns? Prepare for profound pronouncements on the primary problems of philosophy.
